methodologyNotes: Covers cycling power meters sold at a published US MSRP that measure a rider's mechanical power output in watts via a strain gauge and broadcast it to bike computers or apps. Includes pedal-based, crank-arm, spider-based, and crankset/chainring-based meters for road, gravel, and mountain bikes. Excludes indoor smart trainers, stationary-bike consoles, and estimated-power apps that infer watts without a strain gauge. Price is typical US MSRP in USD for the configuration described. mountType is the sensor form factor (pedal, crank-arm, spider, crankset, chainring, or hub). measurementSides is single-sided (one leg measured and doubled) or dual-sided (both legs measured independently). accuracyPct is the manufacturer-claimed accuracy as +/- percent, lower is better. weightGrams is manufacturer-claimed weight in grams; for pedal-based meters this is weight per pair, for crank-arm/spider/crankset meters it is added weight over the equivalent non-power component; null if not disclosed. batteryType is the cell or format used (e.g. rechargeable-liion, CR2032, CR1/3N, CR2450). batteryLifeHrs is claimed battery life in hours. connectivity lists the wireless protocols broadcast (ANT+/BLE, ANT+, or BLE). powerBalanceMeasured is true only when left/right balance is measured on both sides rather than estimated. cyclingDynamics is true when advanced pedaling metrics (torque effectiveness, pedal smoothness, power phase, platform center offset) are reported. waterproofRating is the published IP ingress rating (e.g. IP67, IPX7). warrantyYears is the manufacturer warranty length in years.

products.name: Favero Assioma PRO RS-2
products.priceNote: US retailer Metier.cc lists the Favero Assioma PRO RS-2 (dual-sided) at "$789.00 USD" (compare-at "$819.00 USD"). $789 matches Favero's official US launch MSRP for the dual-sided version noted in DC Rainmaker's June 2025 in-depth review. Other US retailers price higher (BikeShoes.com shows MSRP $999.99 / now $879.00; RA Cycles geolocated to EUR), so $789 is used as the manufacturer's stated typical US MSRP. The manufacturer page itself displayed only EUR (EUR 687.82) at fetch time.
products.provenance: The official Favero shop page (cycling.favero.com/shop/assioma-pro-rs2, SKU 773-20-02) confirms this is the dual-sided RS-2 — "SPD-SL power meter with power sensor on both sides" — distinct from the single-sided RS-1 and the RS-UP upgrade kit, and states the verbatim specs: Accuracy +/- 1%, Waterproofness IP67, Battery type Lithium-ion rechargeable, Battery duration up to 160 hours per charge, Radio communication ANT+/Bluetooth, Cycling Dynamics available, and Warranty 2 yrs. Metier.cc (US retailer) corroborates the exact model and carries the verbatim US price "$789.00 USD" plus matching specs (dual-sided, +-1%, 160 hours, ANT+/Bluetooth). DC Rainmaker's June 3, 2025 in-depth review further confirms model identity (RS-2 = dual-sided), the June 2025 launch, IP67, the firmware-raised 160-hour battery life, and full Cycling Dynamics suite; weightGrams is left null because the manufacturer states only per-pedal weight (124.8 g) while this field requires a per-pair figure that no page states verbatim.

products.name: Garmin Rally RS200
products.priceNote: US listed price $1,099.99 verbatim on The Peddler Bike Shop product page ("$1,099.99"). Matches Garmin's US MSRP and BikeTiresDirect's listed MSRP of "$1,099.99" for the same dual-sensing SPD-SL RS200 (part 010-02388-02).
products.provenance: The Garmin manufacturer product page (garmin.com/en-US/p/658593) is titled "Garmin Rally RS200 | Power Meter Pedals," confirming this exact dual-sensing SPD-SL model, though its spec table renders client-side and returned only site navigation when fetched. The Peddler Bike Shop listing reproduces Garmin's full spec block verbatim and identifies the item as the "Rally RS200 Dual-Sensing Power Meter," SPD-SL, part 010-02388-02 — confirming the exact model (not the single-sided RS100 or the SPD/Look-Keo siblings). That page states verbatim the price $1,099.99 and the specs used here: Accuracy +/- 1%, Weight 320g, Water resistance IPX7, Battery type CR1/3N, Battery life up to 120 hours, Communication ANT+ and BLUETOOTH, plus Advanced Cycling Dynamics, Power Phase, Platform Center Offset, and per-leg Left/Right Balance. Warranty length was not stated on the cited pages, so warrantyYears is null.

products.name: Wahoo Powrlink Zero
products.priceNote: US MSRP $999 for the dual-sided configuration, sourced verbatim from the DC Rainmaker in-depth review (Feb 22, 2022), which lists "POWRLINK ZERO dual-sided: $999USD/999EUR/849GBP/1,299CDN" as the launch price. This is the launch US MSRP; Wahoo has since rebranded the product to "SPEEDPLAY POWER" and lowered EU pricing (dual now EUR 799.99), but no current US MSRP could be sourced verbatim in USD, so the sourced launch MSRP is used.
products.provenance: The Wahoo manufacturer product page was fetched and resolved to the current "SPEEDPLAY POWER Dual-Sided Power Pedals" listing (SPEEDPLAY POWER is Wahoo's current brand name for the POWRLINK ZERO); it confirms this exact dual-sided model with 276 g per pair, up to 75 hours battery life, dual-band ANT+/Bluetooth connectivity, measured left/right balance from dual-sided sensors, +/-1% lab-tested accuracy, and a 2-year limited warranty. The DC Rainmaker in-depth review (dated Feb 22, 2022) corroborates the model identity as the "POWRLINK ZERO dual-sided" (both pedals contain power sensors) and states the launch US MSRP verbatim as "$999USD", plus +/-1% accuracy, 138 g per pedal (276 g/pair), IPX7 water resistance, rechargeable battery, and explicitly "Pedaling Dynamics: No". Both pages agree this is the dual-sided both-pedal-sensor configuration, not the single-sided variant.

products.name: 4iiii Precision 3+
products.priceNote: US MSRP $339.99 USD from the 4iiii US shop "PRECISION 3+ Non-Drive Side Factory Install" page (shop.4iiii.com), which is the price for the power meter installed on a customer-supplied left crank arm. The Ride Ready configuration (pre-installed on a new Shimano crank arm) is listed at $334.99 USD on shop.4iiii.com.
products.provenance: The official 4iiii product page (4iiii.com/precision-3-plus/) confirms this is the single-sided PRECISION 3+ "Non-Drive Side" model — shown side by side with, and distinct from, the dual-sided PRECISION 3+ PRO (29 g, up to 550 hrs) — and its Key Specifications table lists +/-1% accuracy, CR2032 Coin Cell, up to 800 hrs battery life, IPx7 waterproof rating, 9 g weight, ANT+ & Bluetooth Smart, and a 3 year warranty; Left/Right Balance is shown as a dash for this model while the Cycling Metrics row (pedal smoothness, torque effectiveness) is present. The 4iiii US shop Factory Install page (shop.4iiii.com) corroborates the identical PRECISION 3+ single-column spec table (Non-Drive Side, +/-1%, CR2032, 800 hrs, IPx7, 9 g) and describes it as a "crank-based power meter," and lists the price of $339.99 USD for the power meter installed on a customer-supplied crank. Both retailer pages price the sibling PRO separately, confirming this entry is the base single-sided sensor and not the dual variant.

products.name: Stages Power LR Shimano Ultegra R8100
products.priceNote: BikeTiresDirect lists "MSRP: $864.99" (set) for the Stages Gen 3 Ultegra FC-R8100 LR dual-sided power meter crankset; GPLama's 2023-05-23 review independently states "Pricing: US$864.99" for the same Ultegra R8100 DUAL. Used $864.99 as the typical US MSRP for this configuration. Note: the manufacturer's own SPIA/Stages store currently shows Regular Price $889.99 discounted to a Special Price $399.99 (clearance), so the market MSRP of $864.99 is used instead.
products.provenance: The Stages Cycling manufacturer product page (SKU R8100-LR, titled "Stages Power LR Shimano Ultegra R8100 Dual Sided Power Meter") confirms the exact model and states +/- 1.5% accuracy, "Only adds 15g to base crank arm", "175+ hours (coin cell: CR2032)", and "Water resistance rating: IPX7". BikeTiresDirect's listing for the same "Gen 3 Ultegra FC-R8100 LR Power Meter Crankset" corroborates the model identity, describes it as a crank arm-based dual-sided bilateral power meter with ANT+ and Bluetooth SMART compatibility, and lists MSRP $864.99. GPLama's dated 2023-05-23 review of the "Ultegra R8100 DUAL" independently confirms +/-1.5% accuracy, ANT+/Bluetooth wireless protocols, 2x CR2032 / 175hrs battery, IPX7, and US$864.99 pricing.

products.name: Power2Max NGeco
products.priceNote: Typical US price for the NGeco spider-only base configuration is US$490. GPLama dated review states verbatim "Price: From €490 / US$490 / AU$890", and Power2Max North America's store (power2max.cc) lists the NGeco Open Source spider-only at "$490.00 USD". (Official power2max.com EU page lists it at 340,00 €, not USD.)
products.provenance: The official power2max.com NGeco Road page confirms this exact model as a spider-based, dual-sided power meter with "+/- 2%" accuracy and a "2 years" warranty (priced there at 340,00 €). The GPLama dated review (Oct 15, 2020) of the "Power2Max NGeco Power Meter" confirms identical model identity and supplies the US price ("US$490"), the "CR2450" battery with "Up to 300hrs" life, "ANT+ / Bluetooth Smart" wireless, and "2 years" warranty; it also shows L/R balance and pedal smoothness are paid data upgrades (US$59 each), not standard. Power2Max North America's store independently lists the NGeco spider-only at "$490.00 USD" and states the meter "estimates" left/right contribution rather than measuring it independently, so powerBalanceMeasured is false.

products.name: Sigeyi AXO SL
products.priceNote: Sigeyi's own manufacturer store (sigeyishop.com) lists the AXO SL for SRAM 3-bolt road crank (SKU AXO SL-SRAM-3-4-110) at "$ 389.5 Price excl. Tax"; the same $389.5 figure is shown for the SRAM 3-bolt MTB variant. Priced in USD on Sigeyi's global store and excludes tax; treated as typical MSRP for the AXO SL spider.
products.provenance: The Sigeyi manufacturer spec page (sigeyishop.com/axo-sl-2/) confirms this exact model — "AXO SL Power Meter Spider" — with a published spec table: Accuracy ±1.0%, Water resistance IP67, Battery Life 300h, Battery Type Rechargeable Li-ion, Connection technology ANT+ and Bluetooth 4.0, data output including Pedal Smoothness, and Warranty 2 year. The manufacturer store product page for the AXO SL (SRAM 3-bolt road crank, SKU AXO SL-SRAM-3-4-110) lists the price verbatim as "$ 389.5 Price excl. Tax". An independent dated review (GPLama, 2026-01-09) further corroborates model identity as the new AXO SL spider power meter and confirms its left/right balance is estimated rather than independently measured (supporting powerBalanceMeasured=false); measurementSides and added-weight-over-non-power-component were not disclosed per the methodology's definitions, so both are left null.

products.name: Magene P505
products.priceNote: US MSRP $349. Magene official US store page lists "P505 Spider-based Power Meter $349.00"; GPLama review states verbatim "Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price: US$349".
products.provenance: The Magene official product page for the P505 Spider-based Power Meter confirms model identity ("Product Name: P505", "P505 Spider-based Power Meter") and lists the spec table used here (±1% power accuracy, ANT+/Bluetooth, IPX7, 200h endurance, Magnetic Base Rechargeable Lithium Battery) at a US price of $349.00. GPLama's dated (2022-12-21) hands-on review independently corroborates the same spider-based P505 with MSRP US$349, ANT+/BLE, IPX7, up to 200hrs battery, and a 2-year warranty. weightGrams is null because Magene lists 110g as the total spider weight (S1078) rather than the added-weight-over-non-power figure the methodology requires, and measurementSides is null because a spider measures combined power and estimates balance rather than measuring both legs independently.

products.name: Rotor 2INpower SL
products.priceNote: US MSRP $1,099 at launch, stated verbatim in BikeRadar's spec block ("Price: £860/€999/$1,099") and corroborated by Cycling Weekly ("$1,099/£860"). The official ROTOR page displays "See Price" with no numeric figure.
products.provenance: The official ROTOR B2B product page (b2b.rotorbike.com/2inpower-sl) confirms this exact model — the "2INpower SL" dual-sided power meter — stating 530g weight, 250h riding time, "RIGHT & LEFT INDEPENDENT" measurement, and +/- 1.5% power accuracy. BikeRadar's June 20, 2023 launch article carries a full spec block for the same model confirming US MSRP $1,099 (£860/€999), a Rechargeable Li-ion battery, 250-hour battery life, IP67 waterproof rating, ANT+ and Bluetooth connectivity, and that it broadcasts advanced metrics such as torque effectiveness and pedal smoothness (cyclingDynamics). Cycling Weekly independently lists the same $1,099 price, ±1.5% accuracy, 530g weight, IP67 rating and 250h battery, corroborating both the price and model identity. weightGrams is null because the methodology requires added weight over a non-power crankset for crankset meters, which is not disclosed (only total crankset weight is); warrantyYears is null as no figure appears on the cited source/corroboration pages.
